title: Family Lake house W/Pool minutes from downtown
description:
Super Hosts invite you to reserve your stay at this beautiful ranch style lakefront home.  Located just minutes from downtown Nashville. A perfect vacation for your family, multiple families, family reunions, celebrations or just relaxing and enjoying the best of both worlds. Enjoy the pool (open Memorial Day thru Labor Day, depending on weather) or lake, shopping, great dining and kick off your heels on Broadway.  We do require the purchase of insurance offered by Airbnb.

The space
This home is has a fully equipped kitchen, barbecue, dining al fresco or formal dining inside. The beautiful lush property is right on the lake with a private dock. There is something for everyone!

Guest access
Due to weather the pool is NOT in use and is covered during the fall and winter months. October - April. During the summer months. The pool IS in use and to be enjoyed from May - September.

Other things to note
We do require a private booking confirmation contract to be signed before your stay
